datum.faceSeam: independent tangential x gap; never treated as y-C01
datum.contact: face rear y=−2 touches cleat front y=−2; roof/side screw engagement into cleat occurs y=55 at body-supported span 0…62

camPocket.entrySurface: low cleat top z=t+16, high cleat bottom z=H−t−16

edgeChannel.totalToolStrokeUnknownReason: Полный ход инструмента неизвестен: геометрия фрезы и конического наконечника не задана номинальной осью канала.

bodyClearance.entrySurface: roof exterior z=H, floor exterior z=0, side interior x=W−t or x=t

cam16.execution: Rastex 15 without rim nickel, panel t16 cleat

dowel.execution: Rapid S DU325 metal pin with included blue expanding Ø8 anchor

bodyScrew.execution: Предлагаемый размер Ø3,5×30 мм; головка, резьба, точный артикул и совместимость с выбранной плитой не подтверждены.
bodyScrew.count: 2×2 blind rail roof/floor + 2×1 filler rail side = 6
bodyScrew.buying: Шуруп выбирается для проекта отдельно; наличие в комплекте эксцентрика не подтверждено.

value.subject: 38 mm worktop on continuous support top panel, NOT Rastex corpus joints
value.datum: floor z=0; leg underside of body bottom z=100; body H=720; top panel upper surface/worktop underside z=820; worktop upper surface z=858
value.penetrationFormulaMm: p=L_screw−T_support−S_fitting−H_seat; every term from screw tip direction along z; p enters worktop from its underside

layerDefinitionsMm.L_screw: effective axial distance from actual under-head bearing plane to tip of selected screw, per its manufacturer
layerDefinitionsMm.S_fitting: actual added bracket or other intermediate fitting thickness along axis; zero only when expressly no fitting
layerDefinitionsMm.H_seat: signed change of path from under-head bearing plane relative to nominal inner supporting face: positive for added washer/standoff, negative for a verified recessed seat; zero only for illustrative flush head
layerDefinitionsMm.R_top_required: required residual thickness from screw tip to visible surface of selected 38 mm worktop, exact manufacturer/material figure unknown

value.limitFormulaMm: 0<p≤38−R_top_required; R_top_required comes from selected top/screw maker; selected material and fastener may also set lower/other limits

demonstrations.scenario: illustration only, direct through 16 mm roof, no fitting and no sunk head, L30
illustration only, direct through 18 mm roof, no fitting and no sunk head, L30
selected bracket thickness unknown; cannot compute depth

projectMaker: actual worktop material/laminate/underlayer and support scheme
screw/bracket and fixing locations/count/pitch avoiding corner roof screws
manufacturerConditional: selected screw/bracket exact article and head seat
permitted screw penetration/residual top web for chosen 38 mm material
value.screenAndParts: top height, nominal top outline and cabinet design available with project fixing unknown; no universal hole pattern
